title: PXAPI stage execution record v1
description: One stage's own execution within an Analysis Run. It is orthogonal to the global run state: this document carries no global state member, the run state document carries no stage member, and neither is derived from the other. A record with status FAILED therefore does not make the run FAILED — whether a given stage or provider failure is fatal is an orchestration policy decision that no contract in this slice makes. A record is written when a stage begins, so there is no status for a stage that has not started; the absence of a record means no such record is present and carries no further meaning.

schema_version.description: Required. Always 1.0.0 for this contract. Each contract is versioned in its own right; this value is not a version of the contract set as a whole.

run_id.description: Required. The Analysis Run this stage execution belongs to. It is the only link to the run's state document.

stage_id.description: Required. A stable machine-readable stage identifier. The vocabulary is deliberately open: this contract fixes the token's lexical shape, never the set of stages, so a stage a later slice introduces validates here without a schema change. A consumer treats a stage_id it does not know as an unknown stage, never as an error.

status.description: Required. This stage execution's own status, from a closed four-value vocabulary. There is no PENDING and no QUEUED: a record exists only once the stage has begun, so a pre-start status would duplicate the absence of the record. This is not the global run state vocabulary and is never projected onto it.

started_at.description: Required. When this stage execution began — which is also when this record came into existence.

finished_at.description: Conditional. Present if and only if the status is terminal — SUCCEEDED, FAILED or CANCELLED. A RUNNING stage has not finished, so the member is absent rather than null.
